faqs.q: Can a villa book without the guest on the thread?

faqs.q: Do I need meditation cushions?
faqs.a: No. A stable chair or a cushion you already use is enough. Each adult needs a separate comfortable place to sit.

faqs.q: Can two adults join the same guided meditation session?
faqs.a: Yes. The published 60-minute format includes one or two adults when the room and appointment are confirmed.

title: Mobility coaching or personal training: which home session fits?
description: Compare mobility coaching and personal training at home: session focus, room setup, Bali and Jakarta prices, clinical boundaries and what to request.
primaryQuery: mobility coaching or personal training at home

faqs.q: What is the main difference between mobility coaching and personal training?
faqs.a: Mobility coaching centres on controlled range and non-clinical stretching. Personal training centres on a coached strength and fitness workout.

faqs.q: Can either service treat an injury?
faqs.a: No. Both are fitness services. Diagnosis, injury treatment and rehabilitation require an appropriate clinical professional.

faqs.q: Can I include both services in a programme?
faqs.a: They can be scheduled as separate named visits when the dates, professionals, location and complete written quote are confirmed.
